title: W-25: enable GitHub scanners after the flip and allowlist the test TLS fixtures
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-25 (info). Dependabot, secret scanning and code scanning are disabled. After a public flip expect alerts on the three committed .invalid TLS test keys under test/fixtures/tls, which are deliberate fixtures; nothing may ever trust that test CA. Settings changes are the operator's and follow the flip.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Scanners are enabled after the flip and test/fixtures/tls/ is allowlisted in the same pass
